data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root hul, meaning 'to be soft, gentle, delicate'. In Islamic tradition, the name Hulyah is associated with the gentleness and compassion of God. The name Hulyah carries the meaning “Gentle, delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hulyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
